content.title: GUNTHER definitely knows that he can kill Brock Lesnar’s WWE career and retire him
content.text: Cain A. Knight is a hardcore number-cruncher who has analyzed and covered pro wrestling for Cageside Seats since 2014, and followed the sport as a fan going back to the 1980’s.In a new interview with Complex Graps The Podcast, WWE star GUNTHER was asked which wrestler’s career is next on his kill list, after he sent legends Goldberg, John Cena, and AJ Styles into retirement over the last year.The Ring General said he doesn’t have a list, he’s just very good at observing the landscape and taking advantage of opportunities. That’s when Brock Lesnar’s name was brought up to him as a potential candidate. GUNTHER didn’t hesitate to say he knows he can end Brock’s WWE career.Complex: “They’re saying Brock is close to the end.”GUNTHER: “To be honest, let’s see. I think he’s got his hands full right now.”Complex: “You think you can do it?”GUNTHER: “Yeah, I can do it.”Complex: “I don’t think there’s a doubt in this man’s mind.”GUNTHER: “No, I can do it. But first thing’s first. Let’s see. I don’t know where Brock is…he’s [not] around that much. And you don’t really hear or see much, so, I got to do my intel. But maybe a guy owes me that knows what his plans are. I’m just saying maybe…I don’t know.”Latest Video from SB NationThe hottest NFL teams to ever reach the Super Bowl NEXT About Connatix Visit Advertiser websiteGO TO PAGEThroughout the 59 years spanning 1966-2024, the NFL produced 118 conference champions. As they entered the Super Bowl, they were all on a winning streak and playing at a high level to have won their conference, but there still exists a vast range of precisely how good. Focusing specifically on the latter stages of a season, who were the biggest juggernauts we've ever seen entering Super Sunday? And when that day rolled around, how exactly did that recent dominance manifest itself?Brock Lesnar’s long-time advocate, Paul Heyman, happens to owe GUNTHER a favor for solving his Seth Rollins problem this weekend at WrestleMania 42. It seems to me that the Ring General is once again observing the landscape and sees an opportunity to kill Lesnar’s career, now that Paul owes him.Does GUNTHER’s answer make you think he will end Brock Lesnar’s WWE career next, perhaps as soon as later this year in The Beast’s backyard at SummerSlam Minnesota? Will this career killer angle all be worth if it leads to no more Polish Joe in WWE?Let me know how badly you want to see this happen (or not) in the comments below, Cagesiders.12 Comments
